title: AAPS 2.8: recurring issue with AAPS restart on event "Firing EventNewBg" - AAPS gets no BG values
body:
Well this is a really annoying issue as my productive AAPS does not work anymore since nearly 900 minutes. It happens last evening 21:xx without any interaction by me in a sudden and it was not possible to bring back the application working again. What i'm using:
Dexcom G6 App, patched - unchanged since at least 1 year. Still working properly
Android APS 2.8 (off. release, no beta) since about release date. Not working correctly
Beside: xdrip+, but not used as data collector. Only used for statistics and checking SMB values. Still working in version e14bae1-2020.07.13
Pump: insight pump, with firmware: V3.00.17

What I did for remediation:
+ Stopped AAPS. Started again: No help
+ Stopped phone. Booted again. No help.
+ deleted caches of AAPS and Dexcom App. Started apps again: no help
+ Stopped AAPS from OS. Deleted AAPS 2.8 from phone. Reinstalled last off. release of V 2.7. Started again AAPS. no help. BG values keeps off the app. In Dexcom BG values are still there.
+ Reinstalled AAPS 2.8. Then set to virtual Pump: no change. BG values don't appear
+ Then set AAPS to IC: no help. No BG values receivable.

Issue: Desxcom App sends each 5 minutes a BG Value to AAPS, AAPS crashes in a sudden, not BG value received and in  care portal I can find now dozens of items: AndroidAPS started, each 5 minutes.
I watched the logs and found all time after this, ie.
11:27:30.208 [pool-19-thread-1] D/DATABASE: [DatabaseHelper$2PostRunnable.run():448]: Firing EventNewBg
The event is always the same, time is changing in a 5 minutes pattern.
A few lines later comes this - take a look at the times. Normally we have some ms in between. here it increases up to some seconds and that indicates that the app has a crash - no logs any more.  
I attached all logs, but the behaviour can be found in any file. At first glance maybe something with the BT drivers or general with the BT stack. 
Please take a look for this. may it help to reset the AAPS database from AAPS menu to get the internal app communication back to work ?

comments.body:
I found a solution by:
+ Deletion of the local Dexcom App
+ Mobile restart to init 
+ Complete Re-Install of Dexcom App (same Version as before) on mobile 
After the BT Communication was re established with Transmitter the BG values appeared again in AAPS.
It was a quite weired siituation to See AAPS crashing and restarting in a 5-minutes Mode and having no current BG values in  AAPS. Regards.
